hooks.name: Plannotator plan review
hooks.description: Third-party plan-review hooks for entering and exiting plan mode.
risk_notes: Exit-plan hook can run for long plan review windows.
Policy remains separate from repo-owned hook-registry rows until the G1 unification task.
hooks.notes: First curated external row. The unified harness-neutral policy lives in config/plannotator-hooks.policy.json (G1 T-012a). config/grok-plannotator-hooks.json remains the Grok render template; later waves may collapse it into a derived projection.

hooks.name: Atuin agent shell history
hooks.description: Capture Claude Code and Codex Bash tool commands into local Atuin history, tagged by author.
risk_notes: Observational only (context mode) via hooks/atuin-agent-hook.sh; missing Atuin must not block Bash.
Do not also run atuin hook install against live settings — wagents merge is the SSOT so home sync cannot drop PostToolUseFailure.
hooks.notes: Rows atuin-claude-* and atuin-codex-* in config/hook-registry.json. History DB stays on the machine; Atuin Cloud is out of scope.
